title: Scorer
description: A scorer in git: settings of a built-in scorer, or a rubric scorer.

kind.description: builtin: the threshold and filters of a built-in scorer. rubric: an LLM judge scores a sample of closed tasks against a rubric file, on a machine with `swarmupd.judge.scorers: true`.

scorer.description: builtin: the built-in scorer this file sets; the file name when unset.

pass.description: The threshold. A built-in's is in its unit and direction (`swarmup scores` lists them); a rubric's is a share from 0 to 1. A machine's `swarmupd.scorers.<id>.pass` wins.

applies_to.description: Which of this store's work it scores; every list that is set must match. All of it when unset.

labels.description: Labels, of which a task carries one.

roles.description: Roles of the agent whose work it is, such as engineer.

workflows.description: Workflows a task's milestone was started from.

enabled.description: Default true; false turns the scorer off for this store's work.

judge.description: rubric: the judge; `swarmupd.judge` fills what it leaves out.

sample.description: rubric: the share of subjects judged, from 0 to 1. Default 1; a machine may only lower it (`swarmupd.scorers.<id>.sample`).

blind.description: rubric: the judge does not see which agent did the work. Default true.
